title: Add Pinata file download button

requirements.text: Add a download button in the Vault Publishing Controls that appears after a successful IPFS upload to Pinata, allowing users to retrieve and download the uploaded files (images and metadata JSON) from Pinata

quotes: Add a download button to retrieve the files from Pinata after a successful upload

acceptanceCriteria: Download button is visible only after a successful Pinata upload completes
Button triggers download of the files that were uploaded to Pinata (NFT images and metadata)
Existing upload functionality and UI remain unchanged
Button integrates seamlessly with the current VaultPublishingControls component design

constraints: Do not modify any existing upload logic or UI behavior
Keep all other features and components exactly as they are in the current draft version
Maintain the current Pinata integration approach using JWT authentication
nonGoals: Changing the upload process or Pinata configuration
Altering any other pages or components beyond VaultPublishingControls
